name: io.github.notwhiteblank/scholar-rag-mcp
title: Scholar RAG MCP
description: Academic-paper knowledge-base MCP server: ingest PDFs (MinerU), metadata normalization, section annotation, Qdrant vector search with reranking, two-phase KB management. 11 tools: search_chunks, search_documents, list_documents, get_document, get_document_text, add_document, remove_document, create_kb, delete_kb, list_kbs, get_job.

environmentVariables.name: SCHOLAR_RAG_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Data root directory (knowledge bases, caches, jobs)

environmentVariables.name: SCHOLAR_RAG_CHAT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint for annotation/keywords (e.g. local vLLM)
